name: Bear Adjustment vs Condensed Twins
personnel: Peso Dime (4 DL + 2 LB + Hybrid Walk-Downs)

summary.motive: Answer condensed splits by tipping the tite box into a bear look, doubling every interior gap and walking hybrid defenders onto the twins so gap-scheme runs die at the line and quick game gets pressed.
summary.keyDefender: EDGE — the head-up end whose inside slip of the kick-out turns the puller’s lead block into an empty lane for MIKE
summary.whyItWorks: Condensed formations invite gap runs with kick-out logic; the bear tip spills every kick, funnels the ball carrier into the filled apex, and puts pressed defenders on the twins to erase the perimeter answers.
summary.failureMode: Horizontal detachment: jet sweep, wide pin-pull, and quick screens test whether the walked-down hybrids can scrape fast enough to defend space outside the compressed box.

beats.title: 1. Condensed Twins Demand a Bear Answer
beats.text: The offense compresses its splits, so the tite box answers by tipping into a bear look: four linemen within a yard of the ball, both apexes cheated down, and peso plus dime walked onto the twins. Eight defenders live between the tackles.

beats.title: 2. The Puller Meets a Squeezing Edge
beats.text: The guard pulls into a hole that is already closing. The tight end fires his kick-out but the head-up end slips it inside rather than taking the block head-on — classic bear-front spilling that turns the puller’s lead into decoration.

beats.title: 3. Walked Peso Forcing From the Condensed Side
beats.text: On the perimeter, the walked peso triggers downhill and defeats the slot’s crack, while dime shields the alley safety. The condensed-side quick-game answers are jammed before they can threaten.

beats.title: 4. Power Dies in the Eight-Man Box
beats.text: The back hits the line exactly where the design wanted — and finds the spilled kick, the funneling 4i, and the filling Mike stacked in one gap. The alley safety arrives as the ninth hat for a tackle at the line.

relations.tell: Both 4is slid OUTSIDE their base shades with apexes cheated to 3.5 yards — four hats within a yard of the LOS versus three in the pure tite picture.
